data.standardized_narrative: Opening (31 Dec 2017) gross claims outstanding reported at USD 202.366m. The report does not present a clear, standalone gross prior-year movement (movement in prior years' provision) figure in the readable pages; no explicit gross prior-year release or strengthening amount could be unambiguously located in the available images. As a result no quantified prior-year development is reported here.
data.data_quality_notes: Document images were partially legible. I was able to read the balance sheet and the headline gross written premium total (USD 420,079) and the claims outstanding comparative (USD 202,366 at 31 Dec 2017). I could not find a clear, unambiguous gross prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) in the readable note text or a clearly extractable gross claims development triangle in the provided images. Where only net or P&L prior-year 'claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years' lines appear (these are P&L flows, not the reserve movement), they have been ignored per instructions. I have therefore returned null for the prior-year development and left segmental premium mix and claims triangle blank. Amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD) and given in millions.
